title: Windows Over Which Late Fees Standing on a Granite Ridge Pass Account Are Gathered
content:
| The pass record | Refusals in the three whole months ending on the handling date | Window over which the late fees standing are gathered |
| --- | --- | --- |
| no longer admits the holder | at least as many as the number the tier tolerates before privileges are reviewed | every late fee raised on the pass account since the plan was opened |
| no longer admits the holder | fewer than the number the tier tolerates | the three whole months ending on the handling date |
| any other position | any | not widened by this rule |

The schedule above governs how far back the late fees standing on a Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme pass account are gathered. Where the pass record no longer admits the holder and the pass account carries at least as many refusals in the three whole months ending on the handling date as the number of refusals the tier tolerates before privileges are reviewed, every late fee raised on the pass account since the plan was opened is gathered. Where the pass record no longer admits the holder and the refusals in that window are fewer than the number the tier tolerates, the late fees raised in the three whole months ending on the handling date are gathered. In any other case the window is not widened by this rule.

Note 1. The state of the pass record is read before the refusals: neither row of the schedule is reached while the record still admits the holder.

Note 2. The tolerance in the second column is the tier's own published figure for refusals tolerated before privileges are reviewed, and it differs across the programme.

Note 3, worked on a hypothetical account. A Granite Ridge Local Pass, which tolerates 3 refusals, whose plan was opened in September, with late fees of 25.00 raised in October, 25.00 in December and 25.00 in the one whole month ending on a handling date in February. Where the record no longer admits the holder and 3 refusals stand in the three whole months, all three fees are gathered, giving 75.00. Where the record no longer admits the holder and 1 refusal stands, the December and February fees are gathered, giving 50.00. Where the record still admits the holder, the window is not widened by this rule.
